limits: Recipe identity is a constrained full-vertex/topology contract, not independent proof of arbitrary geometry.
Nonadjacent BVH intersections exclude triangles sharing any vertex; adjacent noncoplanar foldover is not fully certified.
Float64 plane/SAT is numerical tolerance testing, not exact symbolic or continuous parameter-domain proof.
Pure model contract: exactly one object, of type MESH; no modifier, shape key, constraint, parent, object/mesh animation_data or drivers. Photographic scene.blend is not accepted here.
World-space signed volume is checked separately from local volume; this recipe also requires identity object transforms.
One closed connected shell is required; no allowed-pair exception exists. Interior islands are rejected by connectivity/recipe identity even when no surface intersection exists.
No fabrication, load, stability, ergonomics, GPU, WebGL, iPhone, or dynamic z-fighting verification.
